content.user_title: Build Production ML and RAG Systems
content.value_statement: Production ML systems are hard to design, deploy, and monitor consistently. This skill guides MLOps, LLM integration, RAG architecture, and local workflow scaffolds.
actual_capabilities: Explains production ML patterns for scalable processing, deployment, monitoring, and reliability.
Provides reference guidance for LLM integration, RAG architecture, and MLOps production patterns.
Includes local Python CLI scaffolds for deployment, RAG, and monitoring workflows.
Lists common development, training, deployment, and monitoring commands for ML projects.
Covers security and compliance topics such as access control, encryption, PII handling, and audits.
limitations: The included scripts are scaffolds and return placeholder success output.
It does not implement real model training, serving, retrieval, or monitoring logic.
Some documented commands reference files and flags that are not included in the package.
Architecture guidance is broad and requires adaptation to each project.

use_cases.title: Plan an MLOps Platform
use_cases.description: Create a deployment and monitoring plan for models that need reliability, cost controls, and audit trails.

use_cases.title: Review a RAG Architecture
use_cases.description: Evaluate retrieval quality, latency, observability, security, and scaling choices before implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize ML Delivery
use_cases.description: Define team practices for testing, release gates, monitoring, and incident response across ML services.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Deployment Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ML service idea and list the deployment, monitoring, and security requirements. Ask clarifying questions before proposing architecture.

prompt_templates.title: Design an MLOps Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an MLOps workflow for this model. Include data validation, training, deployment, rollback, monitoring, and ownership checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate RAG Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this RAG architecture for retrieval quality, latency, security, observability, cost, and failure modes. Provide prioritized recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Run Production Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a production readiness review for this ML platform. Cover SLOs, incident response, compliance, capacity planning, and technical debt tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Design a deployment plan for a churn prediction model.
output: A staged rollout plan with validation, canary release, rollback criteria, and ownership checkpoints.
Monitoring recommendations for data drift, prediction quality, latency, errors, and business impact.

output_examples.input: Review a RAG chatbot architecture for production risks.
output_examples.output: A prioritized review covering retrieval quality, access controls, latency budgets, observability gaps, cost drivers, and failure modes.

output_examples.input: Create an ML monitoring checklist for a new service.
output_examples.output: A checklist for model metrics, data quality, service health, alert thresholds, incident routing, and retraining triggers.

best_practices: Provide model purpose, data sensitivity, latency goals, and deployment environment before asking for architecture guidance.
Ask for trade-offs among accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and compliance.
Validate generated plans with your infrastructure, security, and legal owners before implementation.
anti_patterns: Treating the scaffold scripts as production-ready implementations.
Requesting deployment commands without confirming environment, credentials, and rollback requirements.
Skipping data privacy, monitoring, and incident response in ML system designs.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan production ML systems, MLOps workflows, LLM integration, RAG architecture, and monitoring practices.

faq.question: Does it deploy models automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and local CLI scaffolds, but real deployment logic must be implemented by your team.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes RAG architecture guidance for retrieval quality, observability, scaling, security, and deployment planning.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are the included scripts production ready?
faq.answer: No. The scripts are scaffolds that parse arguments and return placeholder status output.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide model type, data sources, sensitivity level, latency targets, infrastructure, compliance needs, and operational owners.
